race.comment: WARREGO (6) is a four-start maiden from the Maher yard and having his first run in this area. Shows ability and looks very well placed in this line-up. Expected to measure up. FLASH KERMY (7) ran a far improved race second-up, narrowly beaten here over 1100m. Fitter again and looks poised to break through. ZOUTARA (12) is returning from a spell of eight months. Finished sixth at Kyneton over 1203m at the first run last prep. Now with a new trainer, Tommy Logan. Can measure up at the first run for a new barn. NATALIE JOY (10) showed good early speed then led into the straight when fresh from a spell last start before fighting on to finish third, beaten half a length, over 1100m at this track. Has ability and a bold showing is expected. MACAVERTY (2) was good here fresh when finishing fourth but beaten less than two lengths. Fitter again and can measure up.
